faqs.q: Sec. 54-34. - MTC Part 6 "Signals - Signs - Markings" amended.
faqs.a:
The Model Traffic Code is hereby amended by amending subsection (1) of section 614
               of Part 6 in its entirety to read as follows:
614. Designation of highway maintenance, repair, or construction zones - signs - increase
                  in penalties for speeding violations.
(1)
If maintenance, repair, or construction activities are occurring or will be occurring
                  within four hours on a local street or state highway, local authorities within their
                  jurisdiction, may designate such portion of the street or highway as a highway maintenance,
                  repair, or construction zone. Any person who commits a speeding violation in maintenance,
                  repair, or construction zone in subject to the increased fines imposed by subsection
                  1705(4).
(
Ord. No. 4384, § 2, 4-15-2013
)
